prompt:
Paint ONE building for a top-down pixel-art JRPG town map, in the classic 3/4 top-down RPG view: the roof is seen from above (it fills the upper coloured block of the guide) and the front wall is seen straight on (the lower block). The attached image is an exact layout guide drawn at the final proportions: keep the outer silhouette, the roof/wall split line, the door (dark brown rectangle, it must stay exactly there, same size, at ground level) and the windows (yellow rectangles) in exactly the same places. You may add small details (eaves, trim, drainpipe, flower boxes, a hanging shop sign next to the door, a small wall lamp, chimney poking above the roof).
This building: a two-storey harbour inn. Blue-grey slate roof with rows of overlapping slates, a ridge, a small dormer; cream plaster walls with dark timber corner posts and a stone plinth; windows with small panes glowing warm amber from inside (the only light); a hanging wooden sign with a bed icon beside the door; flower boxes under two windows. The art pixel is 7x7 image pixels (the building is 272 x 224 art pixels).
Premium modern hi-bit 2D pixel art ("HD pixel art" JRPG look), hand-placed pixels. Every art pixel is a crisp square of the same size across the whole image (about 8x8 image pixels per art pixel). No anti-aliasing, no blur, no soft brushes, no photographic texture, no noise, no dithering checkerboards. Clusters of 3-10 pixels with clear shapes. Hue-shifted colour ramps: shadows lean toward purple/red and are more saturated, highlights lean toward warm yellow. 4-6 shades per material, rich but earthy, worn and lived-in.
Lighting: neutral, soft, even light from the upper left, like a calm overcast evening; NO cast shadows, NO night darkness, NO lamp light pools, NO vignette. (The game engine adds the night lighting on top later, so this must be the clean base colours.)
Background: fully transparent (the magenta in the guide is background). No ground, no shadow, no people, no text.
revised_prompt: Edit the supplied layout guide into ONE isolated two-storey harbour inn sprite, premium crisp hand-placed HD pixel art JRPG 3/4 top-down view. Treat the attached image as an EXACT geometry template, not a loose reference: retain canvas size and building footprint; roof starts at x14 y196 ends x1891 y939, roof horizontal split at y523-537; front wall starts x56 y939, extends to x1849 and bottom edge of canvas. Preserve the precise positions and sizes of ALL eight original yellow window rectangles (four upper x308-421,700-813,1078-1191,1470-1583 at y1036-1177, four lower x308-421,1092-1205,1470-1583 at y1344-1485) and ONE door at x763-918 y1344 to bottom, keep it exactly there at ground level. Do not relocate, remove, enlarge or add any wall windows or door. Make roof blue-grey slate with attractive structured staggered rows overlapping slates, roof ridge along the existing horizontal split, small dormer within roof silhouette. Cream plaster two-storey straight-on front wall with dark timber corner posts and horizontal floor trim, worn stone plinth. Windows have tiny dark mullions and restrained warm amber glazing, ONLY warm light in image; no other emitted light. Flower boxes beneath two windows; small hanging wooden sign with recognizable pixel-art bed icon beside door; restrained ornamental eaves. Flat neutral even overcast upper left illumination, warm yellow highlights and saturated purplish red shadows, rich earthy 4-6 step palette per material. Respect exact simple rectangular external silhouette, especially flat top roof boundary and roof-wall split; no additions outside footprint. Transparent background throughout outside building, replace ALL guide magenta with true alpha transparency, not magenta. No ground or cast shadow or people or letters. Pixel-grid-perfect hard square edges at consistent approx 7x7 source image pixels, no antialiasing, gradients, blur, dithering or texture noise. Finished production-ready game sprite.
